parameters.help_en:
The usage type. Valid values:

Trial: The service supports trial use.

NotTrial: The service does not support trial use
parameters.help_zh:
使用类型。可选值：

Trial：支持试用。

NotTrial：不支持试用
parameters.name: trial_type

parameters.help_en: The parameters for deploying the user instance
parameters.name: parameters

AutoEnableService.description_en:
Indicates whether the service is automatically activated as defined in the template. Valid values:

true: The service is automatically activated.

false: The service is manually activated
AutoEnableService.description_zh:
是否在模板中定义了自动开通服务。取值：

true：自动开通。

false：手动开通

CommodityProvisions.description_en: The commodity details. Some services, such as ACS, require the activation of multiple commodities
CommodityProvisions.description_zh: 商品详情。部分服务（如 ACS）会涉及多个商品的开通

items.description_en: The commodity details. Some services, such as ACS, require the activation of multiple commodities
items.description_zh: 商品详情。部分服务（如 ACS）会涉及多个商品的开通

EnableURL.description_en: The URL for activating the commodity

Status.description_en:
The activation status of the Alibaba Cloud service. Valid values:

Enabled: The service is activated.

Disabled: The service is not activated
Status.description_zh:
云服务开通状态。可能的值：

Enabled：已开通。
Disabled：未开通

EnableURL.description_en:
The URL for activating the Alibaba Cloud service.

This parameter is returned when Status is set to Disabled
EnableURL.description_zh:
云服务开通链接。
当Status取值为Disabled时，返回该参数

RoleProvision.description_en: The information about the service role. If this parameter is empty, no service role is associated with the service
RoleProvision.description_zh: 服务角色信息。若为空表示没有服务角色

AuthorizationURL.description_en:
The authorization URL for accessing the cloud resources of the service.
This URL is returned if the role is not created
AuthorizationURL.description_zh:
服务云资源访问授权链接。
若角色未创建，会返回此链接

ApiForCreation.description_en: The information about the API operation used to create the role

ApiProductId.description_en: The ID of the product to which the API operation belongs

ApiType.description_en:
The API type.
Valid values:

Open: public API.

Inner: internal API
ApiType.description_zh:
API类型。
取值：

Open：开放API。

Inner：内部API

parameters.description_en: The API parameters. ${variable} indicates a dynamic parameter
parameters.description_zh: API参数信息。${变量名}表示动态参数

Created.description_en:
Indicates whether the role is created. Valid values:

true: The role is created.

false: The role is not created
Created.description_zh:
角色是否已创建。取值：

true：已创建。

false：未创建

Function.description_en:
The purpose of the role.
Default value: Default. This value indicates that the role is the default role for the service
Function.description_zh:
角色用途。
默认值：Default，表示该角色为服务默认角色

Status.description_en:
The activation status of the service. Valid values:

Enabled: The service is activated.

EnabledByDefault: The service is activated by default.

Disabled: The service is not activated.

Unknown: The activation status is unknown
Status.description_zh:
服务开通状态。可能值：

Enabled：已开通。

EnabledByDefault：默认开通。

Disabled：未开通。

Unknown：未知

StatusReason.description_en:
The reason why the Alibaba Cloud service is not activated or the activation status is unknown.

This parameter is returned when Status is set to Disabled or Unknown
StatusReason.description_zh:
云服务未开通或开通状态未知的原因。


当Status取值为Disabled或Unknown时，返回该参数
